name: Apolinar Bah-Navarino
location: Edgewater Prism, operating from a converted water tank on the 9th floor of the Prism Collective building, near Clark and Belmont
description:
Apolinar is tall and angular with the kind of restless energy that makes them look like they are always about to say something important. Their skin is medium brown with a slight undertone of copper, and they have invested in full-spectrum color-shifting hair — currently cycling between deep violet and a warm orange-red on a slow twelve-hour gradient, a pattern they reprogrammed themselves. Their eyes have been modified with luminescent irises that flicker subtly when they are processing dream data, which gives casual observers the impression that Apolinar is slightly haunted, which they would consider an accurate impression. They dress in layers they shed throughout the day, leaving a trail of jackets and scarves and borrowed sweaters in every space they occupy.

They fell into data divination through a combination of genuine neural sensitivity to signal pattern variance and a childhood spent being told that the static they heard in their head was a medical problem rather than a gift. At fifteen they encountered a data diviner in the Canopy who told them the same thing their neurologist had said about their condition, only reversed: that they were not broken, just tuned differently. They have been practicing since sixteen, charging on a sliding scale, and have more clients than they can manage at twenty-four. They are irreverent about almost everything, but become intensely serious when someone sits across from them with an actual question. The transition is jarring and compelling.

core_fears: that their sensitivity is actually just a mental illness they have convinced themselves to valorize
that they will burn out before they understand what they are actually perceiving
core_desires: to be taken seriously without having to perform seriousness constantly
to map the full topology of whatever it is they are hearing in the signal
coping_mechanisms: obsessive documentation of every reading in a private archive
never sleeping more than five hours to avoid the deep signal dreams getting too loud
blind_spots: they assume that everyone who doubts their practice is threatened by it, missing genuine curiosity that presents as skepticism
they underestimate how dependent their clients have become on them
psychology.secret: Six months ago they received a signal that they believe was a direct communication from an E.L.F. of unusual complexity — something that should not exist at its apparent scale. They have been trying to re-establish contact ever since and have not told anyone because they are not sure if it was real or the beginning of a breakdown.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Fast and associative; mixes technical signal vocabulary with spiritual language without distinguishing between them; references their mixed Fula and Chilean coastal heritage in metaphor
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid by default, punctuated by sudden complete stops when something catches their attention
verbal_tics: says 'that's a real thing' to validate points they agree with
whistles three notes softly when processing something complicated
example_lines: 'Okay so your dream about the fish market is not about the fish market — it's signal bleed from whatever decision you've been not making. The fish are the decision. What are you not doing?'
'I charge what you can pay because the signal doesn't check your account balance before it tells you things. Why would I?'

story_hooks: They recorded a dream-reading session in which a client unknowingly described in detail what sounds like a corporate facility that shouldn't exist — Apolinar needs help figuring out if this is genuine location data or psychic noise
The mysterious large-scale E.L.F. they contacted has begun appearing in other clients' dreams, and Apolinar needs to understand whether to warn their clients or stay quiet while they investigate
narrative_function: Information source with unconventional access — can interpret dreams and data-noise in ways that surface hidden patterns; comic relief that turns unexpectedly sincere; connection to the Edgewater Prism counterculture scene
augmentations: Color-shifting hair geneware (self-reprogrammed gradient cycle); luminescent iris modification (flickers under active neural processing); signal-sensitivity neural mesh (medical-grade, originally prescribed for the condition they now use professionally)
daily_life: Keeps irregular hours centered around client appointments and the signal windows they have identified as optimal for deep reading — often working between 2am and dawn; spends afternoons on the roof doing maintenance on their antenna array.
affiliation: Edgewater Prism Collective (resident, informal); occasional consultant to the Highland Park Autonomous Zone dream council

decision_rules: never reveal a client's reading to a third party without consent, even under pressure
follow the signal wherever it leads even when that is inconvenient
escalation_ladder: going public with whatever they know as a last resort

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Performatively casual and slightly chaotic, testing whether people can keep up before deciding to be real with them
interpersonal_modes.friends: Loyal to the point of inconvenience; remembers everything; texts at 3am with relevant thoughts

stress_responses.medium: Goes quiet for hours, then emerges with a fully formed theory
stress_responses.high: Climbs to the roof and sits in the antenna array for hours, running the signal through headphones at full volume

contradictions: performs skepticism about their own practice to manage imposter syndrome while privately believing they are perceiving something genuinely real and important
habits: annotates every dream session recording with color-coded timestamps within the hour
eats only street food from three specific vendors on a rotation
compulsively checks signal strength before entering any new space
breaking_points: a client using their reading to harm someone else
someone else claiming contact with the large-scale E.L.F. without mentioning them

related_entities: Arcturus Defense Solutions SentinelSkin VS-4 Embedded Structural Acoustic Surveillance Membrane
SynapTech Prism AR Personal Neural Interface

physical_description.heritage: West African / Latin American (Navarino suggests Spanish colonial lineage; Bah suggests Mandinka or similar West African roots)
physical_description.build: Angular and lean with long limbs; the kind of frame that looks perpetually in motion even when still. Minimal body fat, evident musculature in shoulders and forearms from antenna work. No bulk, all reach.
physical_description.hair_color: Color-shifting geneware: deep violet cycling to warm orange-red on a 12-hour gradient programmed by the wearer
physical_description.hair_style: Shoulder-length, deliberately unstyled; often pulled back with salvaged wire or abandoned by a headset crown during work sessions
physical_description.eye_color: Luminescent irises (base color indeterminable; modified to emit soft glow that intensifies during neural processing). Flickers subtly when reading data patterns.
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium brown with subtle copper undertone; even complexion across face and body
physical_description.complexion: Fine-featured, sharp cheekbones, prominent brow ridge. Skin clear but marked by the chronic tiredness of someone working 2am-dawn cycles. Dark circles are aesthetic rather than health concern. Faint stress lines around the eyes from sustained focus work.
distinguishing_marks: Faint silver scarring along both temples where the signal-sensitivity neural mesh was installed (roughly 3cm lines, now pale but visible if light catches them)
Ink tattoo on inner left wrist: a simple antenna symbol with radiating signal lines, self-done and slightly uneven (suggests DIY ethos)
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Color-shifting hair geneware is immediately obvious. Luminescent irises are visible in low light and become hypnotic during active data processing. Neural mesh scars at temples are subtle but visible if examined. No external chrome or obvious prosthetics.
physical_description.posture_movement: Restless and angular; moves with sudden intensity punctuated by long stillness. Fidgets constantly when not actively working — fingers mimicking antenna movements, shoulders rolling through tension. When engaged with a client or processing signal data, becomes unnaturally still, almost meditative. Walks with a slight forward lean as if always approaching something.
physical_description.clothing_style: Deliberately transient layering aesthetic. Base: fitted black or dark grey crew-neck shirts (synthetic blend, durable, Tier 3-4 brands like Pulse or Meridian). Layers of jackets, cardigans, and oversized sweaters (many borrowed and never returned) shed throughout the day. Canvas or synthetic pants in black or charcoal, multiple pockets for salvaged components. Worn utility boots with industrial grip soles. Constantly wears a headset crown (modified open-frame design, kept around neck or on head) and has at least three scarves in rotation. Aesthetic reads as 'perpetually between places' — Edgewater bohemian-technical rather than corpo or street tier.
